description: Use this when the user says a client paid an invoice, fully or in part, and asks to record or mark it as paid. Records a payment the client made against an issued invoice, through the same path as recording it in Fatura Go (accounting journal, paid status). Two steps: without confirmation_token nothing is recorded and the result is a preview (invoice, amount, date, method, account, remaining after) with a confirmation_token valid 10 minutes for one use; call again with the same arguments and the token only after the user answered (a confirmation sent within 10 seconds of the preview is refused). amount must be above 0 and at most the remaining balance; an overpayment is recorded in Fatura Go, not here. Not for a Shopify order's invoice. The date must not be in a closed accounting period. method is one of bank_transfer, cash, cheque, card, other: cash posts to cash on hand, any other or none to the default bank account. A recorded payment can be undone in the app; there is no undo tool. Do not use it for supplier bill payments or refunds: those are recorded in Fatura Go.

amount.description: The amount received, in the invoice currency, above 0, at most 2 decimals.

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out: the invoice is then looked up in every business shared with this connection.

confirmation_token.description: Leave out on the first call (preview). Pass the token from the preview only after the user confirmed it, with the same other arguments.

currency.description: Optional check: must be the invoice currency.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the money was received. Default today (UAE).

method.description: One of bank_transfer, cash, cheque, card, other.

reference.description: Bank or cheque reference, if the user gave one.

name: record_payment
title: Record an invoice payment
